summary: People wait in line on a rainy sidewalk outside 169 West 10th Street in New York City before the camera pans to a man holding an umbrella.

people.description: Pedestrians and people waiting in line outside a venue on a rainy street, including a man pushing a stroller with a rain cover and a young man standing with an umbrella wearing glasses and a dark jacket.

moments.action: A crowd waits in a queue outside an awning at 169 West 10th St while a man pushes a stroller with a rain shield past the camera
Camera pans right across the wet street and green bike lane to show a friend holding a patterned umbrella on the sidewalk
good_for: when it rains in the city
